title: WebHealth
description: A full-stack website health auditing platform that combines crawling, Lighthouse, and passive security scans into SEO, performance, and accessibility reports.
overview: Designed and built a website health auditing platform with a Node.js and Express backend and React.js frontend. It integrates a custom multi-page web crawler, Google Lighthouse, and passive security scanning to produce consolidated SEO, performance, and accessibility reports, replacing manual tool-by-tool audits.
features: Consolidated SEO, performance, and accessibility reports

title: Crypto Hunter
description: A React web application that displays real-time market data for the top 50 cryptocurrencies using API integration.
overview: Developed a React.js web application with API integration to display real-time market data for the top 50 cryptocurrencies.

title: Mobivax
description: A vaccination appointment web application with OTP verification and Mapbox geolocation for healthcare professionals.
overview: Built a web application for registering people for vaccination appointments. The app uses OTP verification and Mapbox geolocation to help healthcare professionals locate registered individuals.
